title: Baked Tripe with Kenyan Spice
description: A unique and flavorful dish that combines the richness of tripe with the warmth of Kenyan spices. Perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Tripe
ingredients.amount: 1 pound, cleaned and cut into 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: Kenyan Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most African markets or online.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the Kenyan Spice Blend, olive oil, aerated vinegar, resinous honey, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tripe to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the tripe to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
